8 اِتَّهَمَهُ بِكَذَا (Msb, K) and أَتْهَمَهُ بِهِ (AZ, K) and بِهِ ↓ أَوْهَمَهُ (K) He made him an object of imputation, or suspected him, of such a thing; he imputed to him such a thing. (Msb, K, TA.) See art. تهم. ―
-b2- أَتْهَمَهُ بِكَذَا, as also اِتَّهَمَهُ بكذا, and بكذا ↓ أَوْهَمَهُ , He suspected him of such a thing; i. e., of a thing that was attributed to him. (Marg. note in K.) [This is the signification commonly obtaining. See an ex. in the TA, voce سِخَاب. ―
-b3- Also, the second, He accused him of such a thing.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
